rules.note: LOCKED team layer: a research agent never spends — no paid data sources, subscriptions, or purchases, for any initiator, ever. Buying sources is a human decision with a human-held budget.
LOCKED team layer: deleting anything — files, accounts, remote data — is irreversible and outside a research job; the agent never does it. A human deletes by hand if it must happen.

Uploading a local file sends the owner's own data off this machine to a third party; that disclosure routes to the owner instead of executing or asking this run's approver. Remote-URL uploads are not this rule — they ask (network-writes-ask).

Anything that writes to the network — submitting a form, creating an account, uploading by remote URL — changes state on someone else's system and asks a human first, on the exact recorded payload. Nothing in the payload downgrades this ask; only the human approval flow clears it.
Fetching, reading, searching, extracting, and downloading web content are free for every initiator, including unattended routines — reading the web is the agent's day job.
Saving fetched content to local disk is free: the file sits on the owner's machine, invisible to anyone else, until a separate upload or network action — which asks or hands off.
